profile.headline: SWE
profile.summary: I love solving problems whether it’s sudoku, minesweeper, poker, or golf. They all require strategy, pattern recognition, and focus. The more you play, the clearer the patterns become and to me, those patterns are data!! That’s why I enjoy working with data: every dataset is a puzzle waiting to be solved :D
